scope: specified call sites while selection state is present; covers both normal and AOD modes where those calls occur
evidence: The selection on_create allocates 56 bytes, stores the pointer at 0x2011999c and creates the tileview before refresh. The destruction callback frees and clears the state slot. The tile preview builder creates a label and sets it to a resolved watchface name or fallback. The tips builder sets a label from tips1.watchface. The tileview and drag callbacks read the event code at the specified sites; the drag-start callback formats a position/total string before setting a label.
limitations: Only the specified setter and getter calls are covered, not all updates or all event paths. Modifying event codes can disrupt drag state or send an incompatible event into a branch. Changing display text does not change the selected face or position. Page state alone is not proof of system-wide quiescence for shared physical entries. No device validation.
